patterns.note: Sections are defined by full-bleed background colors, creating strong visual breaks and distinct content areas.
A very large, bold sans-serif typeface is used for the primary hero statement, which then scales down to a small, persistent header.
The site uses a high-contrast palette of light grey, black, and a vibrant, almost neon, pink as a dominant accent and section background color.
The initial hero text 'Experience.Lab' dynamically scales down and repositions from a large, centered display to a small, sticky top-left header upon scroll.
The page background color transitions smoothly from a light grey to a vibrant pink as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
A Japanese character overlaid on the hero text fades out and disappears as the hero text transforms during scroll.
Decorative 3D floating icons are used within a prominent section to add visual interest and a playful touch.

technique_notes: A scroll-triggered animation system orchestrates a multi-stage hero transformation: a large, centered display text scales down and translates to a fixed top-left position, while an overlaid graphic element fades out. This effect is likely achieved using JavaScript for scroll progress tracking and CSS transforms/opacity for the animation.

The page's primary background color transitions smoothly between two distinct solid colors (light grey to vibrant pink) as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, creating a strong visual shift.

Content sections and decorative elements, such as the 3D icons, are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement (likely using css-keyframes or JavaScript-driven animations).

design_tokens.type_scale: An oversized, bold sans-serif hero heading (~5-6x body text) dynamically scales down to a small, regular weight header, while body text remains legible and clean.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous negative space around the hero and between major content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The most distinctive element is the dynamic hero text that transforms from a massive, centered display into a small, sticky header upon scroll, accompanied by a background color transition and a fading graphic. This creates a highly interactive and memorable introduction.
